# The Sea, the Sea

*[Iris Murdoch](../philosophers/iris-murdoch.md) · 1978 · *The Sea, the Sea**

A Booker Prize-winning novel. A retired theatre director keeps a journal by the sea and shuts himself up in the memory of a youthful love: the book stages the power of fantasy that keeps us from seeing others as they are.
